original_question.question: The tetrahedron shown has volume 120. Each marked point is the midpoint of the edge on which it lies. Find the volume of the part containing vertex A after the tetrahedron is cut along the shaded plane.

The figure shows a net of a right triangular prism with equilateral triangular bases. The three rectangles are joined along the common edges shown. When the net is folded into the prism, which labeled point is the other endpoint of the lateral edge with one endpoint at P?
Choices:
A: Point Q
B: Point R
C: Point S
D: None of these three points
